findings.defect: The function decodes the ausearch bytes to text and then zips two independently computed line lists: raw_lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True) over BYTES, and text.splitlines(keepends=True) over STR. bytes.splitlines() breaks only on \r, \n and \r\n; str.splitlines() additionally breaks on \x0b \x0c \x1c \x1d \x1e \x85 \u2028 \u2029. auditd's ausearch --raw output embeds \x1d (GROUP SEPARATOR) between each record body and its interpreted suffix, so str yields roughly twice as many lines as bytes, zip() truncates to the shorter list, and every pair after the first \x1d is misaligned.
